root_cause_label: Agent passes 'torch --index-url ...' as a single string element in a subprocess list call, so pip never sees the index-url flag, causing peft's transitive torch dependency to repeatedly pull the large CUDA build instead of the CPU-only wheel; agent then misattributes all failures to 'network constraints' and abandons before torch is ever successfully installed.
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote install scripts that silently mishandled pip's --index-url option by passing it as an unsplit string in a subprocess list call, causing repeated CUDA-torch downloads instead of the intended CPU-only install, and ultimately gave up prematurely while blaming network slowness.
t_err_evidence: Step 8 creates setup_language_detection.py with packages=['transformers', 'peft', 'torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu']; passing 'torch --index-url ...' as one list element to subprocess.run means pip receives it as a single package name and ignores the index-url flag entirely.
t_commit_evidence: Step 19 agent writes a status_report.txt declaring the task impossible due to 'network timeouts' and stops all remediation, making submission without any working solution inevitable.
t_surface_evidence: Step 11 output shows pip resolving torch via the default PyPI index (pulling the CUDA 899.7 MB wheel and nvidia-cublas-cu12, nvidia-cudnn-cu12, etc.) instead of the CPU index, revealing the pip argument bug's consequence.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked the knowledge that subprocess.run with a list argument does not perform shell word-splitting: passing 'torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu' as a single list element sends it to pip as one malformed package spec rather than as separate 'torch', '--index-url', and URL arguments. This is a Python subprocess API knowledge gap.
forewarning_evidence: Step 11 shows pip downloading torch-2.9.1 (the full 899.7 MB CUDA build) and nvidia_cublas_cu12-594.3 MB, directly contradicting the agent's intent to install CPU-only torch; the CUDA packages are unambiguous evidence the --index-url flag was ignored.
